title: Initial researched processing method families
summary: The normalized corpus includes alignment, spectral denoise, coherence/Wiener masking, MVDR, CLEAN spectral lines, echo persistence, eigen-noise projection, modulation analysis, room profiling, harmonic-product evidence, spectral tilt, multi-domain coherence fusion, dynamic filtering, TDOA/spatial and composite fusion.
invariants: Methods are classified by semantic result: transform, measurement, mask, alignment, spatial, classifier or composite.
Parameters are explicit configuration, not hidden implementation constants.
Method alternatives and parameter sweeps are expected to coexist as separate derived branches.

provenance.claim: Historical Python audio-processing research corpus from which methods were normalized.
Normalized method catalogue and second-run treatment.
